anomalies.observed: The 0 Ω links R9 and R20 connect the PWM1 path to both M5Stack bus pins 20 and 22. Likewise, 0 Ω links R4 and R14 connect the PWM2 path to both bus pins 19 and 21. Each pair of bus GPIO pins is therefore shorted together.
anomalies.expected: Only the jumper mapping appropriate to the M5Stack Core variant should be shorted; the alternate mapping should remain open. The specification describes the mapping as selected by assembly-time jumper population.

evidence.quote: R9–R12 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2
Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3 / Short R9, R11 for others

anomalies.impact: The selected PWM outputs also electrically join alternate M5Stack GPIO pins. This can cause GPIO contention or incorrect operation when a Core variant uses one of the joined pins for another function.

parsed.summary: The netlist connects both alternative GPIO mappings for each PWM channel through 0 Ω links, shorting bus pins 19/21 and 20/22. The specification calls for selecting the mapping for the Core variant rather than connecting both alternatives.
